capabilities.label: Human handoff
capabilities.description: Pause automation at an explicit trust boundary and let the user complete a visual or sensitive step.

capabilities.label: Appshot
capabilities.description: Attach the current application state as visual context for a handoff.

messageBlocks.agentInstructions: When a user must take control for login, CAPTCHA, approval, MFA, payment, or another sensitive visual step, emit one human-handoff block and stop automating that step. Prefer protocol spice for remote desktops. Use data {id,title,instructions,protocol,target?,gatewayUrl?,appshotUrl?,appshotAlt?}. target may be an https URL or a spice/spice+tls endpoint; gatewayUrl is an optional HTTPS SPICE web gateway. Never include passwords, tokens, or cookies in URLs. Wait for a later user completion message before continuing.

example.title: Complete sign-in
example.instructions: Take control to finish MFA, then choose Continue.

onboarding.label: Ollama
onboarding.description: Install Ollama and pull a local model for private on-device inference.
